figure.title: Figure 11. Effect of thickness ratio and thickened root sections on the variation of drag coefficient at zero lift with Mach number for the wing-body configuration.
figure.x_axis: Mach number, M (scale shared with the lower panel, labels under the lower panel). Grid every 0.05 from 0.40 (left frame) to 1.20 (right frame), 17 vertical lines about 96.6 px apart; labels every 0.1.
figure.y_axis: Drag coefficient at zero lift, C_D0, upper panel scale. Grid every 0.005 from 0 (bottom frame) to 0.04 (top frame), 9 horizontal lines about 96.6 px apart; labels every 0.01.
figure.content_note: NACA faired curves only, no symbols, for wings 1, 2 and 3 (47 deg sweep; 4, 6 and 9 percent thick), each labelled with its wing number at both ends ('Wing 2 1 3' from top to bottom on the left, '3 2 1' from top to bottom on the right). All three curves start at M = 0.50 and end at about M = 1.122. Each curve is solid up to about M = 1.04, dashed from about M = 1.045 to about M = 1.09 (two dashes and gaps), then solid to its end. Subsonic order from the top: wing 2 (just below the C_D0 = 0.01 line), wing 1, wing 3; the three curves converge and cross between M = 0.89 and 0.94, where they run inside one band of ink with the C_D0 = 0.01 line.
